colors.name: Press Black
colors.role: Body text, all borders, pill outlines, button strokes - the sole ink color, used at full opacity for every foreground element

colors.name: Bone White
colors.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, pill fills - the only surface color, creating maximum contrast against Press Black

colors.name: Smoke Gray
colors.role: Hairline dividers, muted outlines, secondary borders where a softer separation is needed

fonts.name: Standard
fonts.role: Display and heading type only - a custom geometric sans used at two large sizes with extreme negative tracking (-0.045em to -0.054em). Also sets link and button text. The single weight (400) and tight tracking create a compressed, poster-like presence that dominates the page. No bold variant exists; hierarchy is achieved through size and tracking alone.

fonts.name: Times
fonts.role: Body and micro-copy type - the system serif at 13px, used in editorial contexts (footnotes, annotations, fine print). The serif/sans collision with Standard is deliberate: the sans shouts, the serif footnotes.

components.name: Pill Button
components.role: All clickable actions - nav toggles, social links, CTAs

components.name: Body Paragraph
components.role: Primary prose content - bio text, descriptions

components.name: Dashed List Item
components.role: Service offerings, client names, recognition entries

components.name: Footnote Link
components.role: Superscript annotations referencing email, social, etc.

components.name: Social Pill Row
components.role: External profile links (LinkedIn, Instagram, Soot, Behance)

components.name: Logo Lockup
components.role: Brand mark at top-left of page

do: Use 129.6px border-radius on every interactive element - no rectangles, no modest rounding
Set all display text in Standard at 45-54px with -0.045em to -0.054em letter-spacing
Render body text in Times serif with ~1.70 line-height for editorial breathing room
Anchor all content to the left edge - no centering, no max-width containers
Prefix list items with an em-dash (-) instead of bullets or numbers
Use #000000 for all borders, text, and outlines - never introduce color
Maintain #ffffff backgrounds everywhere; let the 1px black border define shape, not fill
doNot: Never add color - no accent, no semantic green/red/yellow, no brand color
Never use box-shadow or elevation - depth comes from border definition, not shadow
Never use border-radius below 129.6px on any element
Never bold the display type - Standard ships in one weight (400) and that restraint is the system
Never use a sans-serif for body text - the serif/sans split is structural, not optional
Never center-align headings or body paragraphs
Never add imagery, photography, or illustration - the page is pure typography and label geometry
